render.prompt:
Image 1 is a real phone photo of a room to edit. Image 2 is a placement guide: the same photo with numbered translucent boxes showing where each product goes; use it only for position and scale and never draw its boxes or numbers. Images 3 to 7 are the reference photos of products 1 to 5, in order.
1. Add product 1: Beige Textured Loveseat Sofa (sofa), real size 170.2 x 96.5 x 88.9 cm (width x depth x height). Against left wall with back to wall, facing right into room. It belongs inside box 1 of the placement guide. Copy product 1 exactly from its reference photo: Rectangular two-seat loveseat in beige textured fabric with rounded arms, loose back and seat cushions, and dark tapered wooden legs. Same shape, proportions, color, material, texture, pattern and details, scaled to its real size relative to the room.
2. Add product 2: Cream geometric criss-cross rug (rug), real size 182.9 x 121.9 x 1.3 cm (width x depth x height). Centered on floor in front of sofa with long edge parallel to left wall. It belongs inside box 2 of the placement guide. Copy product 2 exactly from its reference photo: Rectangular low-pile area rug in cream with subtle raised criss-cross geometric weave and soft woven wool texture. Same shape, proportions, color, material, texture, pattern and details, scaled to its real size relative to the room.
3. Add product 3: Glass Column Floor Lamp (floor lamp), real size 33 x 33 x 149.9 cm (width x depth x height). In back-left corner by window behind end of sofa, shade above seat height. It belongs inside box 3 of the placement guide. Copy product 3 exactly from its reference photo: Tall slender floor lamp with square black base, clear glass column with vertical black rod, topped by large white drum linen shade. Same shape, proportions, color, material, texture, pattern and details, scaled to its real size relative to the room.
4. Add product 4: Round Traditional Coffee Table (coffee table), real size 96.5 x 96.5 x 48.3 cm (width x depth x height). Centered on rug in front of sofa, long side parallel to sofa. It belongs inside box 4 of the placement guide. Copy product 4 exactly from its reference photo: Round honey pine coffee table with thick wood top, four curved cabriole legs, and lower round shelf. Same shape, proportions, color, material, texture, pattern and details, scaled to its real size relative to the room.
5. Add product 5: White Cylindrical Planter with Stand (planter), real size 43.9 x 43.9 x 49.2 cm (width x depth x height). On floor in right corner under window by outlet, below sill to keep view open. It belongs inside box 5 of the placement guide. Copy product 5 exactly from its reference photo: Tall cylindrical off-white ceramic planter pot supported by a four-legged dark walnut wood stand with vertical dowels. Same shape, proportions, color, material, texture, pattern and details, scaled to its real size relative to the room.
Remove: cardboard moving box front; cardboard moving box back; rolled grey mat. Show the floor and wall that were behind them, continuing the surrounding texture, so it looks like they were never there.
Hard rules: keep the exact same camera position, framing, lens distortion and perspective. Keep the walls, wallpaper, floor, ceiling, ceiling light, windows, blinds or curtains, doors and every object that is not listed exactly as they are. Keep the existing light direction, color temperature and exposure; new products receive the same light and cast soft, physically plausible contact shadows. The result must look like an unedited phone photo of the same room, not a render. Do not add anything else: no extra decor, no text, no numbers, no colored boxes or outlines.
